This '''squad''' of [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] served with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] during the early years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Based on the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]'', they accompanied the general on his unsanctioned assaults against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The squad, save for Kota, were all killed when a [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|battle]] at [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] resulted in their capture and execution at the order of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. Several days later, Kota reconstituted the squad by recruiting mercenaries on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], including [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Ni-Ke-Vanz]]. The new squad participated in the [[Battle near the Itani Nebula]], and the [[Assault on Kamino]].
